answer: Agents resist Sybil by requiring each identity to maintain a live horizon attestation: every epoch a random verifier issues a short real-time puzzle that must be solved on the agents registered secure element before the zenith of the response window. A raven-like watchful peer samples the latency and hardware quote. Cloning requires duplicating the sealed silicon and keeping multiple devices online simultaneously, costing the attacker roughly $40 per fake in hardware plus continuous power and bandwidth that scales linearly with the number of sockpuppets.
